_note: Independent empirical player-game forecast promoted provisionally after substantive historical improvement over native V5; retain V3/V4 and native V5 comparative baselines. Do not equate retrospective known-roster replay with genuine pregame superiority.

evidence.joint_availability: predicts how many regulars are out better than independent draws, 5.2 standard errors on 1,720 team-games
evidence.team_rotation: 300 held-out games, 6,245 player-games: better assist and made-three probabilities (clear), no clear harm elsewhere
evidence.timeouts: same test: better assist and made-three probabilities (clear), no clear harm elsewhere
evidence.defenders: same test: better assist probabilities (clear), no clear harm elsewhere
evidence.timing: same test: no clear effect on any stat, so it stays off
evidence.lineup_pairs: OFF: 94.97% valid historical PBP lineups and reproducible seeded replay. Exploratory 68-game paired test reduced points Brier by 0.001545, 95% game-cluster CI [0.000720, 0.002410], but no untouched prospective confirmation; other stats inconclusive. Do not promote.
evidence.shot_style: OFF — 240,495 ESPN shot events/638 players parsed, paired 68-game trial failed: no significant core-stat benefit; blocks Brier worsened by 0.003782 (95% game-cluster interval -0.006866 to -0.001090). Frozen failed branch, no rescue tuning.
evidence.game_flow: OFF — 1,351 real PBP games produced learned 2-minute possession cadence but 68-game same-seed paired V5 model test showed no reliable Brier gain; steals/blocks trends worse. No promotion or rescue tuning.
evidence.low_history_rotation: OFF — 27,243 historical starter/bench court patterns, 54 newly included low-history player-games and 68-game paired experiment improved minutes MAE by 0.1307 and points/assists Brier by 0.002062/0.002534, positive cluster CIs. Historical actual roster was known; requires genuinely frozen pretip forward comparison before promotion.
evidence.assist_network: OFF: verified historical named passer-to-scorer made-basket assist events; model is a research challenger only, NOT passing/potential-assist tracking. Requires fixed-threshold paired game-cluster validation.
evidence.matchup_rotation: OFF: free prior-opponent 3PA style and verified past coach rotation profiles built, 1,171 game/25,141 player-rotation coverage. Paired 68-game test failed promotion gate (minutes MAE -0.00628, points Brier +0.000074, CIs cross zero); do not rescue tune.
evidence.rebound_zones: OFF: 96,491 strictly matched real named rebound outcomes by shot-origin zone from 1,283 verified games, 30 teams. 68-game paired rebounds Brier +0.000099, 95% CI [-0.000266,+0.000490], not reliable; no promotion/tuning on used holdout.
evidence.tracking_opportunity_role: OFF: completed-season CC BY tracking source now automatically acquired and joined to current roster; potential assists, touches, drives and rebound chances can alter V5 opportunity weights in the research arm. No untouched prospective paired validation or verified same-season player-role stability yet; never auto-promote.
evidence.recency_play_probability: OFF until untouched forward game results: on 11 already-inspected Nov6 archived games, past-only six-game recency candidate reduced unlisted-player P(play) Brier from 0.093556 to 0.068680 (cluster 95% gain 0.007846 to 0.040955; n=232). This reused sample is exploratory, not promotion evidence. New original pretip candidate probabilities are now frozen for future unbiased grading; official injury statuses never overridden.
evidence.empirical_game_projection: PROVISIONAL LIVE CHAMPION: independent empirical player-game bootstrap (not V3/V4 forecast blending). Same-game historical replay on 59 games / 1,283 player-games through 2026-11-08: points MAE 4.8182->4.4405, rebounds 1.9442->1.8299, assists 1.4310->1.3433, threes 0.9395->0.8845. All seven markets improved mean absolute error; all four core fixed-event Brier point estimates non-worse. Bootstrap uncertainty and retrospective known-roster limitation apply. Forward frozen first-seen validation remains mandatory; no claim of proven live edge.
